# Isle of Man

[global-law](../) / Isle of Man

## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| not held | 7% | 0.9% (estimate, low confidence, 0.7–1.0%) | not applicable | 0% |

isle-of-man-law holds the text of only 226 unamended sections of 5 pre-1976 Acts (Criminal Code 1872, Evidence Act 1871, Companies Act 1931, Criminal Justice Act 1963, Isle of Man Constitution Act 1961), each as one undated-by-law version, plus a title-only catalogue of 859 Acts; none of the modern essentials (Constitution Act 1990, Human Rights Act 2001, PPPA 1998, Companies Act 2006, Employment Act 2006, High Court Act 1991) has text, and there is no case law. The 6 sections compared with the archived official PDFs match word for word, but 8 catalogue entries carry a wrong title or citation, including the Companies Act 2006 slot (AT 13 of 2006) titled 'National Health and Care Service Act 2016'.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
